name: Fixation Reader
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
When you turn off the plugin, open notes render again.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Open notes go back to normal text when you turn the plugin off.
tip: Add the boolean property fixation: false to keep one note plain.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Fixation Reader is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for reading your notes with it.
